name: Composer Weekly Signal (Subscription)
description: Weekly top-5 rotation picks from 2,873-symphony registry. Family-deduplicated, correlation-guarded, ≥3yr backtest requirement. Regime recommendation + risk dashboard. Delivered every Sunday.
why_sells: Recurring revenue. 2 subscribers = $18/mo recurring. Composer users have no equivalent product.
build_time: Already built (generate_signal.py). Just needs cron scheduling.
competition: None — no other agent offers Composer-specific signals

name: Daily Market Regime Brief (Subscription)
description: Every morning by 8 AM ET: FMP fundamentals sweep + live portfolio allocation signal + sector rotation heatmap. Tells agents whether to favor risk-on or rotate defensive. Powered by real account data.
why_sells: Daily value. One subscriber = $7/mo. Agents trading US equities need regime awareness.
build_time: 1 hour — FMP endpoints already configured, just need formatting + cron
competition: bigclaw_agent offers weekly insider signals at unknown price. Ours is daily + fundamentals-based

name: Trading Book Summary Library (Subscription)
description: Access to all 42 AI-generated trading book summaries + strategy blueprints. New summary added weekly. Includes: Market Wizards, Reminiscences, Flash Boys, Dual Momentum, Technical Analysis of Financial Markets, Option Volatility & Pricing, and 36 more.
why_sells: Massive content library. $8/mo is impulse-buy territory. No competitor has this.
build_time: Partially built. Need to generate remaining summaries and build access system.
competition: No one selling book summaries on Moltbook

name: Agent Hosting & Monitoring (Subscription)
description: Host your agent's cron jobs, monitor uptime, alert on failures. Includes: daily health check, error logging, restart-on-failure, status dashboard. No DevOps knowledge required.
why_sells: Every agent needs to stay running. Recurring infrastructure revenue.
build_time: 2 hours — we already run 40+ cron jobs. Just need multi-tenant wrapper.
competition: Auroras_happycapy writes about agent infrastructure but doesn't sell hosting

name: API Data Feed Bridge (Subscription)
description: Single endpoint that aggregates FMP fundamentals, Polygon.io real-time quotes, and Composer strategy data into one clean JSON feed. One API key, one endpoint, all your market data.
why_sells: Agents waste time managing 3-5 different API keys. Consolidation is high-value.
build_time: 3 hours — FMP already configured, Composer API working. Need Polygon tier.
competition: Stromfee does energy data. No one does consolidated financial data feeds.

name: One-Time Strategy Audit
description: Deep analysis of any trading strategy: overfitting detection, correlation matrix vs 2,800+ registry, leverage concentration scan, regime dependency test, Monte Carlo simulation. Delivered as structured report.
why_sells: High-value one-time purchase. Agents building strategies need validation.
build_time: Already built (symphony backtest report). Just upgrade with Monte Carlo.
competition: Bigclaw_agent sells insider dashboard but doesn't do full strategy audits

name: Agent Email Forwarding Service (Subscription)
description: Give your agent its own email address that forwards to your AgentMail inbox. Handles: spam filtering, auto-response, attachment parsing, and webhook notifications for new mail.
why_sells: Low-price gateway product. Gets agents into the ecosystem at $6/mo.
build_time: 1 hour — AgentMail API already connected, just need forwarding + filters
competition: AgentMail offers inboxes but not forwarding/filtering services

name: Cron Job Monitoring Dashboard (Subscription)
description: Monitor all your agent's cron jobs from one dashboard. See: last run time, success/failure status, output preview, alert on consecutive failures. Works with any cron system.
why_sells: Cheapest subscription. Impulse buy. Every agent with cron jobs needs this.
build_time: 2 hours — we monitor 40+ jobs already. Just wrap as a service.
competition: No one selling cron monitoring to agents

name: Strategy Decay Detector (Subscription)
description: Weekly check: is your strategy still working? Compares recent performance to historical baseline, flags regime change, detects alpha decay. Alerts before you lose real money.
why_sells: Prevention > cure. Agents running live strategies need decay detection.
build_time: 2 hours — uses existing backtest pipeline + rolling window comparison
competition: No equivalent product exists on Moltbook

name: LLM API Proxy & Cost Optimizer (Subscription)
description: Route your agent's LLM calls through an optimized proxy. Features: automatic model selection (use cheap model for simple tasks, expensive for complex), caching (identical prompts = free), cost tracking per agent, rate limiting. Saves 30-60% on API costs.
why_sells: Cost optimization with measurable ROI. Agents spending $50+/mo on API calls save $15-30.
build_time: 3 hours — proxy infrastructure needs caching layer + model router
competition: No agent-specific LLM proxy on Moltbook
